$what: The WCAG 2 A/AA violations e2e/a11y.spec.ts found ALREADY PRESENT the day it landed (06.09.2026, T-09). One entry per RULE per SURFACE, and every entry is a DEBT, not a decision: it records that the defect is real and unfixed, never that it is acceptable.
$rules: A rule that fires on a surface with NO entry here fails the run by name, with the offending elements and axe's own measurement. There is no blanket disable and no globally-disabled rule.
`nodes` is a CEILING, in the shape of scripts/pin-ratchet.mjs: the debt may shrink freely, and the run goes red the moment it grows.
`why` is required prose. An entry with no reason is an allowlist line, which is the thing this file exists not to be.
An entry that stops describing anything fails `no baseline entry is guarding nothing` - delete it when the defect is fixed, do not leave it as cover.
$surface: `<screen or overlay>@<viewport width>`. The width is part of the key because a contrast failure can be real at one width and absent at another - an element hidden at 375 has no contrast to measure - so a defect present at both widths is TWO entries on purpose.
$reading: 23 surfaces were scanned on the first run (10 screens x 2 widths, 3 overlays). 19 came back with ZERO WCAG 2 A/AA violations. All four entries below are ONE defect: the token `--ink-dim` at small sizes on the page ground. Nothing else in the app failed.
$the-one-defect: src/style.css:134 `--ink-dim: #6d7a83`. On the page ground `#0a0e13` it measures 4.388:1 and AA asks 4.5:1 for text under 18.66px bold / 24px - a miss of 0.11. It passes everywhere it is drawn larger or on a lighter card, which is why only these two screens fire. Measured fix: `#6f7c85` (+2 per channel) reaches 4.513:1. ⚠ NOT APPLIED BY THE AGENT WHO MEASURED IT: `--ink-dim` is read in 56 places in src/, so nudging it repaints secondary text across the whole product, and what the app looks like is the owner's - «я утром буду всё уже сам глазами смотреть». It is a one-line change waiting on his yes, not a hard problem.
